data.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?

result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's an excellent all-round accounting package, particularly if you want to keep bookkeeping simple, manage GST, prepare BAS and work with an accountant or bookkeeper.

However, the best choice depends on the type of business you run, how many employees you have and how much you want to spend.

## My top 5 accounting software picks

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank reconciliation
- GST, BAS and payroll features
- Great accountant and bookkeeper integration
- Lots of third-party integrations

Australian plans start around \$37/month.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/au/)

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features
- Good for businesses with employees
- Useful inventory and job management tools

Plans vary; Business Lite is around \$35/month.

[Visit MYOB](https://www.myob.com/au)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good invoicing and expense tracking
- Useful financial reporting
- Suitable for service businesses

Australian plans and pricing vary.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

**4\. Reckon**

- Affordable accounting option
- GST and BAS support
- Payroll available as an add-on

[Visit Reckon](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for smaller businesses
- Invoicing and expense management
- Integrates with other Zoho products

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

These choices reflect current 2026 comparisons, with Australian GST, BAS and payroll requirements taken into account. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| General small business | Xero |
| Trades and construction | MYOB or Xero |
| Retail and stock management | MYOB |
| Consulting or professional services | Xero |
| Sole trader | Rounded or Xero |
| Tight budget | Reckon or Zoho Books |


## Let me narrow it down for your business

I'd like to recommend something that gives you the best value rather than paying for features you don't need.

**What type of small business do you operate?**

And roughly how many employees do you have?

With those two details, I can recommend the best software, the most suitable subscription and the approximate monthly cost in Australian dollars.
